selector.rationale: The vignette describes a lesion with marked osteolysis and collapse of the T1 vertebra, which aligns with the characteristics of an osteolytic vertebral tumor. The absence of significant thecal sac compromise and the presence of heterogeneous enhancement after gadolinium administration also support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Metastatic disease
rejected.why: No clear evidence of metastasis from another primary site

rejected.label: Vertebral metastasis
rejected.why: Less specific than osteolytic vertebral tumor and lacks clear evidence of metastasis

rejected.label: Giant cell tumor
rejected.why: Lower score and less specific findings compared to osteolytic vertebral tumor
